cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Core words: Good, Bad and Feelings.

words.en: Lily is amazed by the show.
words.sz: Lily 对这个表演感到惊叹。
words.scene: Lily with wide eyes and an open mouth, watching a magician pull a rabbit out of a hat on stage.
more: Tom was amazed to see the big dinosaur.
Tom 看到那只大恐龙很惊讶。
I am amazed at your drawing.
你的画让我惊叹。

words.sz: 这个新的游乐项目太棒了！
words.scene: Lily and Sam cheering with hands in the air after riding a large colourful roller coaster.
more: You did an awesome job on your homework.
你的作业做得真棒。
What an awesome view from the hill!
从山上看到的景色太美了！

words.scene: Heavy rain and strong wind blowing leaves everywhere, a child holding an umbrella that has turned inside out.
more: Tom made an awful mistake in maths.
Tom 在数学上犯了一个严重的错误。
The food is awful.
这食物难吃极了。

words.en: The football match is very exciting.
words.sz: 足球比赛非常令人兴奋。
words.scene: Children jumping and cheering on a green field, one kicking a ball towards a goal net.
more: We had an exciting day at the zoo.
我们在动物园度过了兴奋的一天。
This book is an exciting story.
这本书是一个令人兴奋的故事。

words.scene: A family smiling and taking a photo in front of a beautiful sandy beach with clear blue water.
more: You look fantastic in that red dress.
你穿那条红裙子看起来棒极了。
The cake is fantastic.
这个蛋糕好极了。

words.en: Tom is frightened of the dark.
words.scene: Tom in bed in a dark bedroom at night, the covers pulled up to his nose, his eyes very wide and frightened, looking at a big dark shadow on the wall; he is not smiling.
more: The loud noise frightened Max.
巨大的噪音吓坏了 Max。
Don't be frightened of the dog.
不要害怕那只狗。

words.en: I am glad to see you.
words.scene: Lily hugging her friend Mia with big smiles on their faces in the school playground.
more: Mum is glad Tom got a good mark.
妈妈很高兴 Tom 得了好分数。
We are glad to help you.
我们乐意帮助你。

words.scene: Tom pinching his nose shut while looking at a bin with flies buzzing around it.
more: I had a horrible dream last night.
我昨晚做了一个可怕的梦。
That film was horrible and boring.
那部电影既可怕又无聊。

words.scene: A silhouette of a scary ghost or monster shape against a dark purple background, with bats flying nearby.
more: She does not like horror stories.
她不喜欢恐怖故事。
That was a real horror show!
那真是一场恐怖的表演！

words.sz: 爸爸对 Tom 很生气。
words.scene: Dad standing with his arms crossed and an angry frown, eyebrows down, mouth a straight line, not smiling, looking down at Tom, who is looking at a puddle of spilled blue paint on the carpet.
more: Are you mad with me?
你生我的气吗？
Mum gets mad when we are late.
我们迟到时妈妈会生气。

words.en: Lily feels nervous before the test.
words.scene: Lily sitting alone at a school desk with a test paper, biting her lip, her eyes worried, her hands holding the pencil tightly, a classroom clock behind her; she is not smiling.
more: Max is nervous in the car.
Max 坐车时很紧张。
Don't be nervous. You will do fine.
别紧张。你会做好的。

words.en: Mum is pleased with the clean room.
words.sz: 妈妈对整洁的房间很满意。
words.scene: Mum smiling and giving a thumbs up in a tidy bedroom where Tom is making the bed.
more: I am pleased to hear the good news.
听到这个好消息我很高兴。
Grandpa was pleased with my gift.
爷爷对我的礼物很满意。

words.en: Tom is always polite to guests.
words.sz: Tom 对客人总是很有礼貌。
words.scene: Tom saying hello and shaking hands with an adult visitor at the front door, smiling nicely.
more: It is polite to say thank you.
说谢谢是有礼貌的。
Please be polite in the library.
在图书馆里请保持礼貌/安静。

words.scene: A group of children singing together happily, holding a microphone in the centre.
more: Football is popular at our school.
足球在我们学校很受欢迎。
Mia has many friends because she is popular.
Mia 有很多朋友，因为她很受欢迎。

words.en: Lily is sad because her balloon popped.
words.sz: Lily 因为气球破了而难过。
words.scene: Lily looking down at a torn rubber balloon on the ground, with tears in her eyes.
more: Don't be sad. It will be OK.
别难过。会好起来的。
The dog looks sad when we leave.
我们离开时，狗看起来很伤心。

words.en: Max is scared of the loud noise.
words.sz: Max 害怕那个巨大的噪音。
words.scene: Max the puppy hiding under a kitchen table with his ears flat and his tail between his legs, shaking, his eyes wide, bright fireworks flashing in the dark window.
more: Are you scared of the spider?
你怕那只蜘蛛吗？
I was scared when I heard the noise.
我听到那个声音时很害怕。

words.scene: A spooky Halloween mask with big teeth and hollow eyes, hanging on a dark wall.
more: The old house looks scary at night.
那座老房子晚上看起来很吓人。
Don't tell scary stories before bed.
睡前不要讲吓人的故事。

words.en: Dad is serious about doing homework.
words.sz: 爸爸对做作业很认真/严肃。
words.scene: Dad sitting at the kitchen table with a serious face, not smiling, eyebrows straight, one finger tapping an open exercise book in front of Tom, who looks at the book.
more: The teacher has a serious look today.
老师今天表情很严肃。
This is a serious question.
这是一个严肃的问题。

words.en: Tom is shy with new friends.
words.sz: Tom 面对新朋友时很害羞。
words.scene: Tom hiding behind Mum's leg, peeking out at a group of smiling children in a playground.
more: She feels shy when she sings.
她唱歌时感到害羞。
Don't be shy, come and play!
别害羞，来玩吧！

words.en: Dad was surprised by the gift.
words.sz: 爸爸对这份礼物感到惊讶。
words.scene: A man opening a wrapped box with wide eyes and an open mouth, looking very surprised, while children watch happily.
more: I am surprised to see you here!
我很惊讶在这里见到你！
She looked surprised at the news.
她听到这个消息时看起来很惊讶。

words.scene: Children looking up at the sky with open mouths as heavy rain suddenly falls, holding umbrellas that are still closed.
more: It is surprising how fast he runs.
他跑得多快真令人惊讶。
The answer was surprising to us.
这个答案令我们惊讶。

words.en: Tom is upset about his toy.
words.sz: Tom 因为他的玩具而难过。
words.scene: A young boy sitting on the floor crying, holding a broken toy truck, looking sad and upset.
more: Mum was upset after work.
妈妈下班后心情不好。
Don't be upset, it's OK now.
别难过，现在没事了。

words.sz: 我们度过了一个美好的假期。
words.scene: A happy family smiling and taking photos together on a beautiful beach with blue water and white sand.
more: The food at the party was wonderful.
派对上的食物很棒。
What a wonderful view!
多美的景色啊！

words.scene: A beautifully decorated birthday cake with smooth icing and neat candles, sitting on a table ready to be eaten.
more: Today's weather is perfect for sports.
今天的天气非常适合运动。
She made a perfect drawing.
她画了一幅完美的画。

words.scene: A puppy lying on its back on a rug in front of a fireplace, eyes closed, looking very relaxed and lazy.
more: Tom feels lazy on Sunday mornings.
Tom 在星期天早上感觉懒洋洋的。
Don't be lazy, help me please!
别偷懒，请帮帮我！

words.en: Sam is very helpful at home.
words.scene: A boy helping his grandmother carry heavy shopping bags into the house, both smiling.
more: This map is helpful for us.
这张地图对我们很有用。
Thank you for being so helpful!
谢谢你这么乐于助人！

words.scene: A table full of fresh fruits and vegetables, including apples, carrots, and broccoli, looking colorful and fresh.
more: Running keeps me healthy.
跑步让我保持健康。
Grandma is old but very healthy.
奶奶年纪大了，但很健康。

words.scene: A big, soft armchair with cushions, inviting and cozy in a warm living room.
more: My shoes are not comfortable.
我的鞋子不舒服。
The hotel bed was very comfortable.
酒店的床很舒适。

words.scene: A girl sitting in a cozy corner reading a book, looking calm and peaceful, with soft light around her.
more: The music sounds relaxing.
这音乐听起来令人放松。
We had a relaxing weekend.
我们度过了一个轻松的周末。

words.scene: A group of children holding a trophy and cheering, looking proud and happy after winning a game.
more: She is a successful singer.
她是一位成功的歌手。
The project was very successful.
这个项目非常成功。

words.scene: A vibrant garden with bright, colorful flowers that seem to glow and attract butterflies and bees.
more: This is an attractive dress.
这是一件漂亮的裙子。
The town looks very attractive.
这个小镇看起来很迷人。

words.scene: A man with a friendly smile and neat hair, looking handsome and stylish in a casual shirt.
more: That dog is very good-looking.
那只狗很漂亮。
He has a good-looking car.
他有一辆好看的车。

words.scene: A large, beautiful public park with many people walking and enjoying the scenery, looking popular and busy.
more: She is a well known teacher.
她是一位著名的老师。
The bridge is well known here.
这座桥在这里很有名。

words.scene: Two children shaking hands after a game, smiling, with a referee standing nearby looking neutral and happy.
more: It is not fair to lie.
撒谎是不公平的。
Let's take turns. It's fair.
我们轮流来，这样才公平。
My dear friend Tom is here.
我亲爱的朋友 Tom 在这里。
Come here, my dear child.
过来，我亲爱的孩子。

words.scene: A plate of golden brown cookies, one with a bite taken out, looking delicious and inviting.
more: The soup is very tasty.
这汤很美味。
Mum makes tasty meals.
妈妈做的饭很美味。
